item.title: Self-Hosted JTAG/SWD Remote Debug Servers: OpenOCD vs pyOCD vs probe-rs
item.description: Debugging embedded systems has traditionally meant connecting a hardware debug probe directly to your development machine via USB. But as embedded development teams grow and CI/CD pipelines extend to hardware-in-the-loop testing, the need for remote, network-accessible debug servers becomes critical. Three major open-source projects — OpenOCD, pyOCD, and probe-rs — each provide GDB server functionality over TCP, enabling remote debugging workflows where the debug probe is physically connected to one machine while developers connect from anywhere on the network.
